sections.heading: B — Audience and scope
sections.markdown:
## B — Audience and scope

Audience: first-time Connecticut applicants preparing in English for the Class D knowledge test; this section matters to every driver facing bad weather and to all drivers holding their temper in traffic.
Level: plain-English reading level; no prior driving vocabulary is assumed, so each manual term is defined where it first appears.
Prerequisites: the basic control, gap and maneuver rules of the prior sections; this section continues chapter three.
Section scope: manual chapter three, third part: hazardous conditions, hydroplaning, aggressive driving and road rage, conflict avoidance and trouble behaviors.
Out of scope: distractions, fatigue, alcohol and drug law, signs and signals, licensing paperwork, and anything not printed on the selected manual pages.

corpus_stability.reason: The Connecticut Driver’s Manual is one dated edition (Revised March 2023, physical p3); nothing on the selected pages indicates more than one rewrite per year.
